workstreams.interim_behavior: Any descriptor/consumer disagreement blocks preparation/execution; presentation remains non-authorizing.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Contract/property/mutation evidence across Inspector, Descriptor, Operation Registry, Traits, Servers and Authorization.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Unknown provider fields/resources cannot widen a reviewed mutation; unsupported constraints deny execution.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Provider field contracts plus compiler/property/mutation fixtures and exact digest binding evidence.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Ambiguous provider effects remain RECONCILING/UNKNOWN; legacy identifiers cannot be silently reinterpreted.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Per-family postcondition readers, contradiction matrices and identifier migration fixtures.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Current options/CAS backend remains authoritative until parity/cutover proof; stale publishers/readers cannot authorize execution.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Shadow-read parity, fencing, cache-coherence, multi-worker and rollback evidence.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Partial completion is preserved; failed sites do not trigger blind replay or cross-site credential/evidence reuse.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Durable NetworkOperation journal and crash/resume/fan-out isolation fixtures.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Fixed dispatch remains correctness path; stale/unknown projection/protocol state cannot widen authority.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Client/protocol compatibility, stale projection, refresh and mixed-generation transport fixtures.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Breaker/lifecycle health can only constrain eligibility; no probe or lifecycle event grants authority.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Durable breaker transitions and WordPress lifecycle parity/recovery tests.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Telemetry is non-authorizing; mandatory audit/evidence failure for governed writes remains fail closed.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Trace propagation/privacy, percentile SLO and observability-outage evidence.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Any impact/resource/dependency drift invalidates approval; routing never grants capability eligibility.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Impact digest invalidation, decision graph and independently verified execution-receipt fixtures.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Unknown crypto/time/replay/canonicalization conditions deny or require reprepare; abuse limits never bypass stronger policy.
Refactors/config changes preserve existing authority contracts; hidden dependency/config widening is forbidden.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Behavior parity, dependency-direction checks, reason-code schema and config-generation tests.

workstreams.interim_behavior: No completeness claim while a P0/P1 dimension lacks owner, interim behavior or evidence path.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Machine-validated dimension/task ownership and traceability/non-authorizing checks.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Stale request/static/replica/hook state cannot authorize or commit; ambiguous DB outcomes reconcile.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Closed: request-scope isolation, authoritative DB topology/read-your-writes, database failure semantics, final hook-order execution seal, recursive child-permit fencing and infrastructure compatibility profile all pass the certified PHP/MySQL/MariaDB runtime matrix.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Foreign clones quarantine; restored old state and changed subjects cannot replay previously valid authority artifacts.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Foreign-clone quarantine, monotonic external restore epoch, same-origin rollback detection, durable replay quarantine, governed post-restore reconciliation, and subject lifecycle invalidation are exact-head certified across the supported WordPress/PHP/MySQL/MariaDB matrix.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Unknown/newer persisted versions and stale code generations fail closed; rollback cannot reinterpret security state.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: N/N-1 rolling deploy, downgrade/rollback and stale-worker generation-fence tests.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Provider side effect without required durable evidence can never be terminal success; it becomes reconciliation-required.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Crash-point matrix, storage exhaustion, archival/hash-chain, truncation and fatal-interruption fixtures.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Post-side-effect cancellation and incomplete/mixed-generation transport stay nonterminal/denied until evidence resolves them.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Cancellation propagation, chunk integrity/decompression bounds and composed cross-fault certification.

workstreams.interim_behavior: Security identity uses canonical encodings only; uncertain collation/storage-engine/transaction ownership blocks governed mutation rather than degrading to alternate identity or non-atomic persistence.
workstreams.evidence_strategy: Canonicalization negatives, binary/collation alias tests, SHOW TABLE STATUS/engine capability evidence and nested transaction/savepoint-or-deny fixtures.
